text.text_excerpt: I came here on a Sunday night for my sister's birthday dinner and we were not disappointed! Her boyfriend planned everything and thankfully made a reservation, which I would recommend because this place was packed! We were promptly seated at a booth which happened to be decorated for the special occasion, with a personalized menu and some confetti spread out across the table. It just made her birthday celebration even more special! Our meal was phenomenal! We started by sharing three different starters: lobster dumplings, crispy pork belly, and the heirloom beet salad. It's fine dining at its best. We had reservations, arrived on time, and were seated within seconds. When our waiter greeted us at our table he used my name, which I though was pretty classy. The service never slid, with our waiters being attentive but allowing us to enjoy the company at the table. Service alone is a reason to go back. It was our first time there so we hit all the recommendations: lobster dumplings, sizzling oysters; and the scalibut. I also got the scallop dinner and it was very good, although not the best looking plate of food (the overall color was light brown due to the mushroom risotto). All the recommendations were spot on however. And yes, the biscuits are excellent...

My husband took me here for our anniversary and they were so kind to print a customized menu with our names on it. I like when restaurants go the extra step to make your evening more memorable when they know it's a special occasion. You feel special as soon as you sit down. Now, in all seriousness I hyped this place up in my head a lot and I still think I had the best seafood dinner of my life here.
